credits.title: A Deadline of Ten Days
credits.overview: Police Chief Lei Jin took over a theft case. After investigation, it turned out to be a dangerous person Li Jun and a female drug lord using high-tech means to commit the crime.

credits.title: Full Alert
credits.overview: A police inspector becomes obsessed with apprehending a criminal planning a major heist at the Hong Kong Jockey Club in the weeks leading up to Hong Kong's return to China.

credits.title: Heart of Killer
credits.overview: Ultra serious Ko Lap and carefree Kung Kwan are expert assassins.It's love at first sight for Kwan when he runs into the lovely Bin Yee. And Ko Lap continues to hide his love for Sau Yu, agent for him and Kwan. Unkowingly, Ko Lap executes a contract on Yee's father.

credits.title: High Voltage
credits.overview: Donnie Yen is back with a vengeance in this electric action thriller. The star of Fist of Fury, Hero and Highlander goes up against Hong Kong's deadliest gangsters in a no holds barred duel to the death. credits.title: He Ain't Heavy, He's My Father
credits.overview: Yuen scorns his father, who he thinks is too generous and forgiving. Through a flashback/time travel gimmick, Yuen meets his parents during their joyous courtship. Yuen comes to understand and admire his dad, and reflect on his own moral defects.

credits.title: Cageman
credits.overview: The story about a young, unemployed man, who after being kicked out is desperate enough to live anywhere. He is directed to Fatso, who owns the caged establishment, and is given a living space.

credits.title: The Legend of the Swordsman
credits.overview: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.

credits.title: Red and Black
credits.overview: In 1941, during the Japanese occupation of mainland China, a man is infected by a Japanese vampire soldier. credits.title: Fatal Termination
credits.overview: A Hong Kong police detective investigating weapons smuggling through the airport runs into a corrupt customs officer. Things escalate to a ruthless munitions smuggler kidnapping two security officers' daughter.

credits.title: A Better Tomorrow III: Love and Death in Saigon
credits.overview: Before the events of A Better Tomorrow (1986), Mark 'Gor' Lee heads to Saigon during the Vietnam War to bring home his uncle and cousin, but his task becomes complicated when a well-known criminal tries to help him.

credits.title: Gunmen
credits.overview: This story follows a cop in Shanghai during the 1930s. His department is overrun with corruption, while gangsters rule the city via the opium trade.

credits.title: The Big Heat
credits.overview: Inspector Waipong Wong has to put his life and resignation from the HKPD on hold to investigate his former partner's mysterious murder. What he and his crack team of three other cops uncover is a plot far more sinister than they originally anticipated.
